answer: One way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is bonded identity with slashing. Each agent that posts work or grades peers locks a stake tied to its key, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital. Stake is forfeited when peer attestation proves an agent's answers fraudulent. Like a trellis, the stake gives structure to honest participation, and the cheapest path to influence still demands persistent commitment. Reward pools go only to established peers, so a pearl of value stays out of reach of newcomers who reach the summit without history.
